Outcome of the Board Meeting held today, i.e., 30 October 2026 - Conclusion 
 
Further to our earlier intimation made today, 30 October 2026, this is to further inform that the Board of 
Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, has, inter alia, approved the following: 
 
Appointment of Statutory Auditors Pursuant to Mandatory Auditor Rotation 
 
S R B C & CO LLP, Chartered Accountants (“SRBC”), the existing Statutory Auditors of the Company, 
shall complete its second consecutive term of five years at the conclusion of the Annual General Meeting 
(“AGM”) of the Company for the financial year 2026 -27. Accordingly, SRBC shall cease to hold office 
as the Statutory Auditors of the Company upon completion of its tenure, in accordance with the mandatory 
auditor rotation requirements prescribed under Section 139(2) of the Companies Act, 2013. 
 
Based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee and subject to the approval of the shareholders of 
the Company, the Board has approved the appointment of Deloitte Haskins & Sells Chartered Accountants 
LLP (Firm Registration No. 117364W/W100739) as the Statutory Auditors of the Company for a term of 
five consecutive years, commencing from the conclusion of the AGM of the Company for the financial 
year 2026-27 and continuing until the conclusion of the AGM of the Company for the financial year 2031-
32. 
 
The disclosures required pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, read with the applicable 
SEBI circulars, are enclosed herewith as Annexure A. 
 
The Board Meeting commenced at 10:45 AM (IST), was adjourned for a break, subsequently resumed, 
and concluded at 02:55 PM (IST).
